title: Korean-Style Plant-Based Burgers
subtitle: with Cucumber Kimchi and Sesame Fries
description: It’s plant power all the way with our super-tasty vegan dishes! Our meat-free, dairy-free, honey-free dishes are amped with plant-based proteins, fresh produce, nuts and seeds. Best of all, they’re for everyone, whether you're vegan, vegetarian or flexitarian.

steps.text: Bake fries: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Peel the potatoes and thinly slice. Stack the slices, then cut into matchsticks and put on the lined tray. Drizzle with 2 tsp vegetable oil, scatter over the sesame seeds, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Bake on the upper oven shelf, turning halfway, for 25-30 mins until golden.

Make cucumber kimchi: While the fries are baking, peel the cucumber into ribbons with a vegetable peeler. Combine 1 tsp chilli paste (see Make it yours), 1 tsp white vinegar and 1 tsp sugar in a large bowl. Add the cucumber and toss to combine.

Cook patties: Combine the remaining chilli paste, 3 tsp sugar and 1 tbs water in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the plant-based patties for 4-5 mins each side until browned. Add the chilli mixture and cook, turning the patties, for 1-2 mins until glazed. Remove the pan from the heat.

Toast buns: Meanwhile, cut the rolls in half. Put on an oven tray, cut-side up, and bake on the lower shelf for 5-6 mins until lightly toasted. Thinly slice the spring onions on an angle. Combine the spring onion and 2 tbs vegan mayonnaise (see Make it yours) in a bowl.
Serve up: Spread the roll bases and tops with the spring onion mayo. Layer the bases with the patties and cucumber kimchi, then sandwich with the tops. Serve with the fries and enjoy!

Make it yours: We've suggested this amount of Korean chilli paste (known as gochujang) in the cucumber kimchi and glaze for flavour, but feel free to reduce to taste if you prefer less heat. ~ If you are not following a vegan diet, use whatever mayonnaise you have on hand.
